senses: to move, go, turn back, move away, backslide
to turn oneself away, turn back
to be turned or driven back, be repulsed

strongs.def: properly, to flinch, i.e. (by implication) to go back, literally (to retreat) or figuratively (to apostatize)
strongs.kjv: backslider, drive, go back, turn (away, back)
